subject.title: fix(agents): drop stale internal orphan prompts

question: Should the stale-reply repair use this PR's six-source internal-handoff drop rule, or should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 remain the canonical repair strategy?
rationale: Both branches target the same canonical issue but choose different session-state semantics, and this external PR still lacks real embedded-agent proof for its narrower drop/preserve split.

options.title: Coordinate on the proven canonical repair
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 as the default landing path unless maintainers explicitly prefer this branch's drop semantics.

options.title: Require proof for this branch
options.body: Keep this PR open but blocked until redacted runtime logs or terminal output show internal handoff text is dropped and `sessions_send` text is preserved.

options.title: Adopt the drop rule deliberately
options.body: Proceed with this branch only if maintainers accept removing all six internal handoff source tools from repaired prompts when a fresh prompt exists.

recommendation.title: Coordinate on the proven canonical repair
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 as the default landing path unless maintainers explicitly prefer this branch's drop semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the queued-user preservation invariant introduced in the merged active-turn repair.
